about.cta.p1: At Manta Shark Aquatics, we make sure all students don't just learn to swim — they master the water for life. We provide your family with a
about.diff.noRelearn.text: We eliminate the frustration of half-built skills. While students have fun, the correct learning foundations are being repeatedly practiced.
about.diff.noRelearn.title: No Re-Learning Required
about.diff.patient.text: We don't believe in "quick fixes." If a skill is vital to your child's safety, we take the effort to ensure they master it completely.
about.diff.patient.title: Patient, Efficient Progression
about.diff.peace.text: With certified lifeguards, experienced instructors, and educational psychologists on the team, your child is in the safest hands.
about.diff.peace.title: Total Peace of Mind
about.diff.subtitle: What makes us different is that we focus on fundamental swim techniques from day one. Our parents stay for the long term because they value a deep, correct foundation over rushed shortcuts.
about.diff.wellbeing.text: We ensure students are healthy, learning at their own comfortable pace, and having genuine fun — turning a scary experience into a joyful routine.
about.diff.wellbeing.title: Holistic Student Wellbeing
about.hero.subtitle: Professional coaching rooted in education, psychology, sports science, and child development — serious about swimming, designed for peace of mind.
about.phil.p1a: Having a team of professionals from unique training and backgrounds, our teaching and training philosophy is like no other. When we say we are
about.phil.p1b: we mean that we take our craft of teaching seriously, and your child's learning experience, safety, and long-term development are our absolute priorities.
about.phil.p2a: As busy professional parents, your time is valuable and your child's well-being is paramount. When you join the Manta Shark family, you can
about.phil.p2b: . We handle the technique, the safety, and the motivation, making swim day a seamless, rewarding, and stress-free part of your family's routine.
about.team.subtitle: Passionate, professional, and effective — we love seeing our students enjoy the fun of swim lessons and demonstrate improvement and progress!
about.us.p1: At Manta Shark Aquatics, we believe swimming lessons should be more than just learning how to move through the water. They should build confidence, safety, discipline, and lifelong comfort in aquatic environments.
about.us.p2: Our team combines professional swimming experience with backgrounds in education, psychology, sports science, behavioral health, and child development — from beginner swimmers to advanced athletes, we focus on structured, progression-based instruction that builds strong fundamentals correctly from day one.
about.us.p3: Parents choose Manta Shark because they know their children are learning in a safe, supportive, and highly professional environment. We aim to make every lesson productive, encouraging, and stress-free for families.

levels.1.desc: At this level, your child will learn how to enjoy the water safely while developing the foundation for swimming skills through playful, supportive instruction.
levels.1.goal.1: Enter and exit the pool safely using safety techniques
levels.1.goal.2: Blow bubbles and submerge their entire face with confidence
levels.1.goal.3: Identify pool safety zones (shallow vs. deep)
levels.1.goal.4: Float on their front and back with light assistance
levels.1.goal.5: Move from floating to standing position independently
levels.1.tagline: Building trust, comfort, and safety in the water.
levels.2.desc: At this level, your child will build foundational water skills through kicking, breath control, and body positioning, while gaining confidence with floating and shallow water movement.
levels.2.goal.1: Demonstrate proper kicking motion on land for 20 seconds
levels.2.goal.2: Kick with a kickboard for 7 yards with proper breathing and body position
levels.2.goal.3: Kick on their back with a kickboard for 5 yards while keeping their face up and body afloat
levels.2.goal.4: Flip back and forth while hugging the kickboard 3 times with control
levels.2.goal.5: Push off the wall and maintain a horizontal float for 5 seconds
levels.2.goal.6: Perform 10 shallow water bubble jumps with controlled breathing
levels.2.goal.7: Hold their breath for 10 seconds underwater
levels.2.goal.8: Retrieve an object from a depth of 2–3 feet
levels.2.tagline: Building early water confidence through kicking, floating, and breath control.
levels.3.desc: At this level, your child stops relying on a kickboard. The kick becomes a real kick, the push-off becomes a streamline, and deep water stops being somewhere to avoid — they can enter it, retrieve from it, and hold a survival float in it.
levels.3.goal.1: Demonstrate proper kicking technique: small, fast flutter kicks with straight legs and pointed toes
levels.3.goal.3: Jump in and retrieve an object from 4–5 ft. depth
levels.3.goal.4: Hold a relaxed survival float in deep water for 30 seconds, conserving energy
levels.3.goal.5: Swim 15 yards independently and comfortably using BBQ swim technique
levels.3.goal.6: Tread water for 15 seconds while keeping their head above water
levels.3.tagline: Moving through the water unaided, with the safety skills to match.
levels.4.desc: At this level, your child will begin swimming independently using proper technique, with a focus on freestyle, backstroke, and swimming with confidence in different conditions.
levels.4.goal.1: Swim 15 yards of freestyle with rotary (side) breathing, strong flutter kicks, and using straight-arm pulls and recovery
levels.4.goal.2: Kick on their back for 15 yards while keeping a straight body line
levels.4.goal.3: Swim 15 yards of early backstroke with proper technique (straight-arm recovery, pinky-first entry)
levels.4.goal.4: Swim 15 yards of early backstroke with proper technique (straight-arm recovery, pinky-first entry)
levels.4.goal.5: Float on their back independently for at least 30 seconds
levels.4.goal.6: Swim 7 yards without goggles while wearing a t-shirt to practice water safety skills
levels.4.tagline: Building stroke fundamentals and early endurance.
levels.5.desc: At this level, freestyle and backstroke get longer and cleaner, the first flip turn arrives, and breaststroke and butterfly kicks are introduced. Your child also learns the rescue that keeps them safe: help from the edge, without going in.
levels.5.goal.1: Swim 25 yards of freestyle with rotary breathing, breath control (2-stroke and 3-stroke breathing), and high-elbow techniques
levels.5.goal.2: Swim 15 yards of backstroke using alternating arms and proper timing
levels.5.goal.3: Perform freestyle flip turns and streamline push-offs with 10 underwater flutter kicks and/or 5 underwater dolphin kicks
levels.5.goal.4: Swim 25 yards of breaststroke with proper kick technique
levels.5.goal.5: Swim 25 yards of butterfly kick with basic coordination
levels.5.goal.6: Reach or throw to a swimmer in trouble from the deck without entering the water, and perform a surface dive
levels.5.tagline: Stroke refinement, the first flip turn, and rescue awareness.
levels.6.desc: At this level, your child will refine all four strokes and build stronger swim efficiency, flip turns, and more advanced water movement skills.
levels.6.goal.1: Swim 50 yards of freestyle with rotary breathing, high elbow recovery, and efficient catch of water
levels.6.goal.2: Swim 25 yards of backstroke using high elbow catch and strong underwater push
levels.6.goal.3: Perform backstroke flip turns and stroke-count finishes
levels.6.goal.4: Swim 25 yards of single-arm butterfly with correct body wave and timing
levels.6.goal.5: Swim 25 yards of breaststroke with proper arm-kick-glide rhythm and breathing
levels.6.goal.6: Perform legal open turns by touching the wall with both hands before rotating and pushing off
levels.6.goal.7: Swim 25 yards without goggles while wearing a short-sleeved shirt and shorts
levels.6.tagline: Mastering technique and learning advanced strokes.
levels.7.desc: The last level before the swim team. Every stroke is swum to competitive form, turns and pullouts are legal, the start comes off the block, and the individual medley ties all four strokes together.
levels.7.goal.1: Swim 50 yards of freestyle with rotary breathing within a set target time using proper technique and flip turns
levels.7.goal.2: Swim 200 yards of freestyle nonstop with efficient breathing, turns, and pacing
levels.7.goal.3: Swim 50 yards of backstroke with strong technique, alternating arm strokes, and smooth body position
levels.7.goal.4: Complete a proper breaststroke underwater pullout (one dolphin kick, one arm pull, one breaststroke kick) after each start and turn
levels.7.goal.5: Swim 25 yards of butterfly using full-stroke technique and competitive form
levels.7.goal.6: Perform a legal racing start from the block and a legal backstroke start from the wall
levels.7.goal.7: Swim 100 yards individual medley (25yd each of butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke, freestyle) without stopping and in the correct order
levels.7.goal.8: Swim 50 yards without goggles while wearing a short-sleeved shirt and shorts
levels.7.tagline: Timed swims, legal turns and starts, and the individual medley.
